prompt:
List 250 distinct kinds of digital hardware building blocks. Together they
should form a broad, representative catalog of what digital designers
build: the kind of blocks found across digital design textbooks and
open-source hardware libraries.

For each kind give:
- name: a short name for the block;
- description: one sentence saying what the block does and what state it
  keeps (its registers or memories).

Rules:
- Every entry is a different kind of block, not a size or parameter
  variant of another entry.
- Describe the block only. Do not state any correctness property, rule or
  relationship that its state must satisfy.
- Leave out these kinds, which are already covered:
  - a FIFO with separate write and read pointers plus an occupancy counter; full and empty are derived, and occupancy always equals the pointer difference
  - a credit counter: a producer spends credits, a consumer returns them; credits outstanding plus credits held always equals the configured total
  - a four-phase req/ack handshake with a busy register; req may not drop until ack rises, and the busy flag mirrors the phase
  - a valid/ready pipeline stage with a skid buffer; the buffered word is only meaningful while the stall flag is up
  - a two-flop synchronizer carrying a gray-coded pointer across clock domains; consecutive pointer samples differ in at most one bit
  - a round-robin arbiter over N requesters with a last-grant register; the grant is always one-hot and never lands on a non-requesting line
  - a fixed-priority arbiter with a lock bit that freezes the current winner until it releases
  - a one-hot FSM; exactly one state bit is ever set, and some transitions are only legal from specific states
  - a binary-encoded FSM whose state register has unreachable encodings; the design never enters them
  - a saturating up-counter that clamps at a maximum below what its register width admits
  - an up counter and a down counter stepped by the same enable; their sum is constant
  - a gray-code counter alongside its binary shadow; the gray value always equals binary XOR binary-shifted-right
  - a shift register tracking in-flight requests with a separate count of set bits
  - a token bucket that refills on a timer tick and drains on grants, capped at a burst size
  - a linear-feedback shift register that never reaches the all-zeros lockup state
  - a watchdog timer that must be kicked before a timeout; the expired flag implies the counter reached its limit
  - a debouncer requiring K identical consecutive samples before the clean output flips; a stability counter never exceeds K
  - a PWM generator with a period counter and duty register; the output is high exactly while the counter is below the duty value
  - a scoreboard counting issued vs retired transactions; retired never exceeds issued and the difference is bounded by the window
  - a ping-pong double buffer with a select bit; the writer and reader never address the same half
  - an elastic (two-entry) buffer with head/tail flags; the occupancy encoded by the flags matches the count register
  - a priority encoder with a registered valid flag; the encoded index is only meaningful while valid is set
  - an accumulator split into two carry-save halves; the halves always sum to the true total
  - a sequence detector for a fixed pattern with a match-progress register; progress never exceeds the pattern length
  - a triple-modular-redundancy voter with three shadow registers; the voted output always equals the majority
  - a sliding-window rate limiter: a shift register of recent grants plus a count of ones that mirrors it
  - a register slice protected by a parity bit; stored parity always matches the stored data
  - a stack pointer with a high-water-mark register; the mark never falls below the pointer and only ratchets upward
  - a DMA burst engine with a beats-remaining counter; the busy flag is up exactly while beats remain
  - a clock divider built from a phase counter; a divided-enable pulse fires exactly when the phase wraps
  - a histogram of N bin counters incremented one at a time; the bins always sum to the total-samples register
  - an in-flight tracker for a pipelined unit: issue increments, a fixed-latency shift register drains; occupancy equals the ones in the shift register

kinds.name: Ripple-carry adder
kinds.description: Adds two binary operands by chaining full-adder carries from the least to most significant bit, holding no internal state in its combinational form.

kinds.name: Carry-lookahead adder
kinds.description: Adds two operands using generate/propagate logic to compute carries in parallel, with optional pipeline registers for the partial carry terms.

kinds.name: Carry-select adder
kinds.description: Computes two conditional sums per block for carry-in 0 and 1 and selects between them, buffering the duplicated block sums.

kinds.name: Carry-save adder
kinds.description: Reduces three input vectors to a sum vector and a carry vector, optionally registering both outputs for the next reduction stage.

kinds.name: Kogge-Stone prefix adder
kinds.description: Performs addition through a parallel-prefix tree of generate/propagate cells, optionally with pipeline registers between prefix levels.

kinds.name: Brent-Kung adder
kinds.description: Performs addition with a sparse parallel-prefix carry tree, keeping only optional stage registers between its forward and backward trees.

kinds.name: Bit-serial adder
kinds.description: Adds two operands one bit per cycle, keeping a single carry flip-flop and a bit-index counter.

kinds.name: Borrow-propagate subtractor
kinds.description: Computes the difference of two operands by propagating borrows through full-subtractor cells, holding only the final borrow bit.

kinds.name: Array multiplier
kinds.description: Forms all partial products at once and sums them in a regular adder array, with optional registers between rows.

kinds.name: Radix-4 Booth multiplier
kinds.description: Recodes the multiplier into signed digits to halve partial-product count, keeping a recoded-digit register and an accumulating product register.

kinds.name: Wallace tree multiplier
kinds.description: Compresses partial products through a tree of carry-save compressors into a final adder, with optional stage pipeline registers.

kinds.name: Shift-and-add sequential multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies over several cycles using a shifting multiplicand register, a shifting multiplier register, an accumulator, and a step counter.

kinds.name: Restoring divider
kinds.description: Produces a quotient one bit per cycle by trial subtraction and restoration, keeping partial-remainder, quotient, and iteration-count registers.

kinds.name: Non-restoring divider
kinds.description: Generates quotient bits from the sign of a running remainder without restoring, holding remainder, quotient, and step-counter registers.

kinds.name: SRT radix-4 divider
kinds.description: Retires two quotient bits per cycle using a redundant quotient-digit selection table, keeping a redundant partial remainder and a quotient-digit accumulation register.

kinds.name: Newton-Raphson reciprocal unit
kinds.description: Iteratively refines an initial seed estimate of 1/x, storing the current estimate and an iteration counter.

kinds.name: Restoring square-root unit
kinds.description: Extracts a square root digit by digit using trial subtractions, keeping partial radicand, partial root, and step-index registers.

kinds.name: CORDIC rotation engine
kinds.description: Computes trigonometric or vector-rotation results by iterative shift-add micro-rotations, holding x, y, and angle accumulator registers plus an iteration index.

kinds.name: Barrel shifter
kinds.description: Shifts or rotates a word by an arbitrary amount in one pass through a cascade of multiplexer stages, holding no state.

kinds.name: Funnel shifter
kinds.description: Extracts a word-width field from the concatenation of two input words at a programmable offset, purely combinationally.

kinds.name: Arithmetic shifter unit
kinds.description: Shifts a signed value right or left with sign replication, optionally registering the shifted result.

kinds.name: Integer ALU
kinds.description: Selects among add, subtract, logical, and compare operations on two operands and produces a result plus condition flags held in a flag register.

kinds.name: Magnitude comparator
kinds.description: Compares two operands and asserts less-than, equal, and greater-than outputs from a chain or tree of bit comparisons.

kinds.name: Equality comparator tree
kinds.description: Reduces bitwise XOR results through an OR tree to signal whether two words differ, optionally registering the match bit.

kinds.name: Absolute-value unit
kinds.description: Returns the magnitude of a signed input by conditionally negating it based on the sign bit.

kinds.name: Two's-complement negator
kinds.description: Produces the arithmetic negation of an operand by inverting bits and incrementing, holding only an optional output register.

kinds.name: Sign-extension unit
kinds.description: Widens a narrow operand to a wider bus by replicating its sign bit or zero-filling according to a mode input.

kinds.name: Population-count unit
kinds.description: Counts the number of set bits in a word using a compressor tree, with an optional registered count output.

kinds.name: Leading-zero counter
kinds.description: Reports how many zero bits precede the most significant one bit of an input word, using a priority reduction tree.

kinds.name: Find-first-set unit
kinds.description: Scans a vector for the lowest set bit and outputs its index and a found flag, optionally registered.

kinds.name: Bit-reversal unit
kinds.description: Reorders a word so bit i maps to bit N-1-i, typically as pure wiring with an optional output register.

kinds.name: Gray-to-binary converter
kinds.description: Converts a Gray-coded input into plain binary via a prefix-XOR network, holding no state.

kinds.name: Binary-to-Gray converter
kinds.description: Converts a binary word to its Gray-coded form by XORing each bit with its neighbor.

kinds.name: BCD adder
kinds.description: Adds two packed decimal operands with per-digit correction logic, carrying a digit-carry chain and an optional result register.

kinds.name: Double-dabble converter
kinds.description: Converts a binary value to packed BCD by iterative shift-and-add-3 steps, keeping a shift register of digits and a step counter.

kinds.name: Seven-segment decoder
kinds.description: Maps a 4-bit nibble to segment drive patterns through a combinational lookup, optionally latching the pattern.

kinds.name: Floating-point adder
kinds.description: Aligns exponents, adds mantissas, then normalizes and rounds, keeping pipeline registers for exponent difference, aligned mantissas, and sticky bits.

kinds.name: Floating-point multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies mantissas and adds exponents, then normalizes and rounds, holding pipeline registers for the product and exponent sum.

kinds.name: Floating-point divider
kinds.description: Divides mantissas iteratively and subtracts exponents, keeping partial-quotient, remainder, exponent, and iteration registers.

kinds.name: Float-to-integer converter
kinds.description: Converts a floating-point value to a fixed-width integer by shifting the mantissa per exponent and rounding, with an optional registered result and exception flags.

kinds.name: Integer-to-float converter
kinds.description: Normalizes an integer into mantissa and exponent fields and rounds to the target format, keeping an optional output register.

kinds.name: Floating-point comparator
kinds.description: Compares two floating-point operands including special-value cases and emits ordering and unordered flags, optionally registered.

kinds.name: Normalizer
kinds.description: Left-shifts a mantissa by its leading-zero count and adjusts the exponent accordingly, holding the shift amount in an internal register.

kinds.name: Rounding unit
kinds.description: Applies a selected rounding mode to a truncated result using guard, round, and sticky bits stored in a small status register.

kinds.name: Saturating fixed-point adder
kinds.description: Adds two fixed-point values and clamps the result to the representable range, keeping a sticky saturation flag register.

kinds.name: Multiply-accumulate unit
kinds.description: Multiplies two operands and adds the product into an accumulator register that persists across cycles.

kinds.name: Dot-product unit
kinds.description: Multiplies several operand pairs in parallel and sums them through an adder tree into a running sum register.

kinds.name: Systolic array processing element
kinds.description: Performs one multiply-accumulate per cycle while forwarding operands to neighbors, holding weight, partial-sum, and pipeline operand registers.

kinds.name: Transpose buffer
kinds.description: Writes a matrix tile in row order and reads it in column order using a two-dimensional register or memory array with row and column index counters.

kinds.name: Modular adder
kinds.description: Adds two residues and conditionally subtracts the modulus, holding the modulus in a configuration register.

kinds.name: Montgomery multiplier
kinds.description: Computes modular products in Montgomery form by interleaved multiply-and-reduce steps, keeping partial-product, modulus, and loop-index registers.

kinds.name: Modular exponentiation engine
kinds.description: Performs square-and-multiply exponentiation over a modulus, holding base, running result, exponent shift register, and bit counter.

kinds.name: GF(2^m) multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies two binary-field elements with polynomial reduction, keeping an accumulator register and the irreducible-polynomial configuration.

kinds.name: CRC generator
kinds.description: Updates a remainder register with each incoming data word using a polynomial division network.

kinds.name: One's-complement checksum accumulator
kinds.description: Accumulates 16-bit words with end-around carry into a checksum register.

kinds.name: Parity tree
kinds.description: Reduces a data word to a single parity bit through an XOR tree, with an optional output register.

kinds.name: Hamming encoder
kinds.description: Computes check bits for a data word and emits the combined codeword, optionally registering it.

kinds.name: Hamming decoder
kinds.description: Recomputes syndrome bits from a received codeword and flips the indicated bit, holding syndrome and error-flag registers.

kinds.name: SECDED memory wrapper
kinds.description: Adds encode-on-write and correct-on-read logic around a memory array, keeping registered syndrome and error-status bits.

kinds.name: Reed-Solomon encoder
kinds.description: Appends parity symbols computed by a shift-register divider over a Galois field, keeping the symbol remainder registers.

kinds.name: Viterbi ACS unit
kinds.description: Adds branch metrics, compares path candidates, and selects survivors, holding per-state path-metric registers and a survivor traceback memory.

kinds.name: Convolutional encoder
kinds.description: Produces coded output bits from a constraint-length shift register of past input bits.

kinds.name: Block interleaver
kinds.description: Writes symbols row-wise and reads them column-wise from a block memory with write and read index counters.

kinds.name: Scrambler
kinds.description: XORs the data stream with a pseudorandom sequence generated from an internal polynomial shift register.

kinds.name: Descrambler
kinds.description: Recovers original data by XORing with a locally regenerated sequence held in a state shift register.

kinds.name: AES round datapath
kinds.description: Applies substitution, shifting, mixing, and key addition to a 128-bit state register for one cipher round.

kinds.name: AES key expansion unit
kinds.description: Derives per-round subkeys from the cipher key, holding the current key words and a round index register.

kinds.name: SHA-256 compression core
kinds.description: Processes a message block through 64 rounds, keeping eight working-variable registers, a message schedule array, and a round counter.

kinds.name: Microcode sequencer
kinds.description: Selects the next control-store address from branch, jump, and increment sources, keeping a microprogram counter and a microsubroutine return register.

kinds.name: ChaCha20 quarter-round core
kinds.description: Mixes four 32-bit words with add-rotate-XOR operations on a 16-word state register array.

kinds.name: Xorshift PRNG
kinds.description: Generates pseudorandom words by shifting and XORing an internal state register each cycle.

kinds.name: Ring-oscillator entropy harvester
kinds.description: Samples free-running oscillator phases to collect raw entropy bits into a collection shift register and sample counter.

kinds.name: Binary decoder
kinds.description: Activates one of 2^n outputs selected by an n-bit input under an enable, combinationally.

kinds.name: Binary encoder
kinds.description: Converts an asserted input line into its binary index, combinationally.

kinds.name: Multiplexer tree
kinds.description: Selects one of many input words using a hierarchy of select stages, optionally registering the selected word.

kinds.name: Demultiplexer
kinds.description: Routes a single input word to one of several output ports chosen by a select field.

kinds.name: Crossbar switch
kinds.description: Connects any input port to any output port through per-output select registers programmed by a configuration write.

kinds.name: Benes permutation network
kinds.description: Realizes arbitrary permutations through two butterfly halves of 2x2 switches whose settings are held in configuration registers.

kinds.name: Universal shift register
kinds.description: Holds a data word that can be loaded in parallel, shifted left, shifted right, or held according to mode inputs.

kinds.name: Multi-port register file
kinds.description: Provides several simultaneous read ports and one or more write ports over an array of addressable registers.

kinds.name: Single-port SRAM wrapper
kinds.description: Wraps a memory macro with address, data, and enable registers for one access per cycle.

kinds.name: Dual-port SRAM
kinds.description: Provides two independent address and data ports into one storage array, with per-port address and output registers.

kinds.name: ROM block
kinds.description: Returns fixed constant data for an applied address, optionally through a registered output stage.

kinds.name: Content-addressable memory
kinds.description: Compares a search key against all stored entries in parallel and returns a match index, keeping the entry array and valid bits.

kinds.name: Ternary CAM
kinds.description: Matches a key against stored entries with per-bit don't-care masks, keeping value, mask, and valid arrays.

kinds.name: Direct-mapped cache
kinds.description: Caches memory lines at index-determined slots, keeping tag, data, valid, and dirty arrays.

kinds.name: Set-associative cache controller
kinds.description: Looks up several ways in a set and sequences fills and evictions, keeping tag, data, state arrays, and a request state machine.

kinds.name: Cache tag array
kinds.description: Stores and compares address tags per set and way, holding tag bits and valid bits.

kinds.name: True-LRU replacement unit
kinds.description: Tracks access recency ordering per set in a stored rank or matrix and nominates a victim way.

kinds.name: Pseudo-LRU tree unit
kinds.description: Maintains a binary tree of direction bits per set and walks it to pick a victim way.

kinds.name: Translation lookaside buffer
kinds.description: Caches virtual-to-physical page translations in a tag/data array with valid, ASID, and permission bits.

kinds.name: Hardware page-table walker
kinds.description: Issues memory reads to traverse page-table levels, keeping level counter, current descriptor, and walk-state registers.

kinds.name: Store buffer
kinds.description: Holds committed store addresses and data until they drain to memory, with per-entry valid and merge bits.

kinds.name: Victim cache
kinds.description: Holds lines recently evicted from a main cache in a small fully associative array with tags and valid bits.

kinds.name: Miss-status holding register file
kinds.description: Tracks outstanding cache misses with per-entry address, target register list, and valid bits.

kinds.name: Snoop filter
kinds.description: Tracks which caches may hold which lines using a presence-vector array indexed by address.

kinds.name: Directory coherence controller
kinds.description: Sequences coherence messages for each line, keeping per-line sharer vectors, owner ids, and stable/transient state fields.

kinds.name: Scratchpad memory
kinds.description: Provides software-addressed local storage with simple address and data registers and no tags.

kinds.name: Line fill buffer
kinds.description: Collects returning beats of a memory line before writing it into the array, keeping a data buffer, beat index, and address register.

kinds.name: Stride prefetcher
kinds.description: Detects constant address strides per program counter and issues ahead-of-time requests, keeping a table of last address, stride, and confidence counters.

kinds.name: Bimodal branch predictor
kinds.description: Predicts branch direction from a table of saturating counters indexed by branch address.

kinds.name: Gshare branch predictor
kinds.description: Indexes a counter table with branch address XOR global history, keeping a global history shift register.

kinds.name: Branch target buffer
kinds.description: Caches predicted target addresses for taken branches in a tag/target array with valid bits.

kinds.name: Return address stack
kinds.description: Pushes return addresses on calls and pops them on returns, keeping an address array and a top-of-stack pointer.

kinds.name: Instruction fetch unit
kinds.description: Generates fetch addresses and captures returned instruction bytes, keeping a fetch pointer and an alignment buffer.

kinds.name: Instruction decoder
kinds.description: Extracts opcode fields and emits control signals and immediates, optionally registering the decoded micro-operation.

kinds.name: Register rename table
kinds.description: Maps architectural registers to physical tags, keeping the map array and a free-tag list.

kinds.name: Reorder buffer
kinds.description: Holds in-flight instruction results and status until in-order commit, with head and tail pointers and per-entry done/exception fields.

kinds.name: Reservation station
kinds.description: Buffers waiting operations with operand values, source tags, and ready bits until their inputs arrive.

kinds.name: Load-store queue
kinds.description: Holds pending memory operations with addresses, data, and age fields and performs address matching between them.

kinds.name: Common data bus broadcast unit
kinds.description: Drives completed result tag and value onto a shared result bus, keeping an output register and tag field.

kinds.name: Hazard detection unit
kinds.description: Compares source and destination identifiers across pipeline stages to produce stall and bubble signals, reading the stage registers.

kinds.name: Forwarding network
kinds.description: Selects operand values from later pipeline stage registers instead of the register file via multiplexer control logic.

kinds.name: Pipeline register stage
kinds.description: Latches datapath values and control bits between stages with enable and flush inputs.

kinds.name: Exception/trap controller
kinds.description: Captures faulting cause and address and redirects control flow, keeping cause, epc, and status registers.

kinds.name: Interrupt controller
kinds.description: Collects interrupt lines, applies priority, and presents a vector, keeping pending, enable, and in-service registers.

kinds.name: Interrupt vector table unit
kinds.description: Translates an accepted interrupt id into a handler address through a programmable table memory.

kinds.name: Control and status register file
kinds.description: Provides architecturally visible configuration and status words accessed by special instructions, each a mapped register.

kinds.name: Performance counter block
kinds.description: Counts selected microarchitectural events in programmable counters with per-counter event-select registers.

kinds.name: Breakpoint comparator unit
kinds.description: Compares instruction or data addresses against programmed watch values, keeping address, mask, and control registers.

kinds.name: Trace buffer
kinds.description: Records a rolling window of sampled signals into a circular memory with a write pointer and trigger-position register.

kinds.name: JTAG TAP controller
kinds.description: Sequences the standard test access state machine and routes data to instruction and data registers.

kinds.name: Boundary-scan register chain
kinds.description: Captures and drives chip pin values through a serial chain of boundary cells with capture and update latches.

kinds.name: Scan flip-flop chain
kinds.description: Provides test-mode serial shifting of functional flip-flop contents through a multiplexed scan input.

kinds.name: Memory BIST controller
kinds.description: Generates march-test address and data patterns and compares read-back data, keeping address counter, pattern state, and fail flag registers.

kinds.name: MISR signature analyzer
kinds.description: Compresses an observed data stream into a signature register updated each cycle by feedback and XOR.

kinds.name: eFuse/OTP controller
kinds.description: Sequences programming and sensing of one-time-programmable bits, keeping a shadow register of read fuse values and a program state machine.

kinds.name: Clock gating cell
kinds.description: Produces a gated clock from an enable captured in a latch transparent on the inactive clock phase.

kinds.name: Glitchless clock mux
kinds.description: Switches between asynchronous clock sources using per-branch synchronizer flops and enable handshake flops.

kinds.name: Digital PLL loop filter
kinds.description: Converts phase error samples into an oscillator control word, keeping proportional and integral accumulator registers.

kinds.name: DLL phase aligner
kinds.description: Adjusts a delay-line tap to align a feedback clock to a reference, keeping a tap-select register and lock flag.

kinds.name: Tapped delay line
kinds.description: Propagates a signal through a chain of buffers and exposes intermediate taps, with optional sampling flops on each tap.

kinds.name: Duty-cycle corrector
kinds.description: Adjusts clock high-time using a measured imbalance stored in a correction code register.

kinds.name: Reset synchronizer
kinds.description: Asserts reset asynchronously and releases it synchronously using a short chain of flip-flops.

kinds.name: Power-on reset generator
kinds.description: Holds reset asserted for a programmed number of stable clock cycles counted in an internal counter.

kinds.name: Pulse stretcher
kinds.description: Extends a short input pulse to a fixed output duration using a reload counter and an output flag.

kinds.name: Edge detector
kinds.description: Flags rising or falling transitions by comparing a signal with its value stored in a delay flop.

kinds.name: Cross-domain mailbox register
kinds.description: Holds a data word written in one clock domain and read in another, with set/clear flag flops on each side.

kinds.name: Isolation cell controller
kinds.description: Drives clamp enables for signals crossing into powered-down regions, keeping sequencing state bits.

kinds.name: Power gating controller
kinds.description: Sequences retention save, switch ramp, and restore steps, keeping a sequencer state register and acknowledge flags.

kinds.name: DVFS controller
kinds.description: Requests voltage and frequency operating points based on load inputs, keeping current-point and request-pending registers.

kinds.name: Temperature sensor interface
kinds.description: Samples a sensor conversion result periodically into a reading register with threshold compare registers.

kinds.name: UART transmitter
kinds.description: Serializes a byte with start, parity, and stop bits, keeping a shift register, bit counter, and busy flag.

kinds.name: UART receiver
kinds.description: Samples an asynchronous serial line at mid-bit and assembles a byte in a shift register with bit counter and framing-error flag.

kinds.name: Baud rate generator
kinds.description: Divides a system clock to produce bit-time and oversampling ticks using a divisor register and a phase accumulator.

kinds.name: SPI master

picked.name: Forwarding network
picked.description: Selects operand values from later pipeline stage registers instead of the register file via multiplexer control logic.

picked.name: SD card host controller
picked.description: Issues command/response transactions and block data transfers, keeping argument, response, and transfer-state registers.

picked.name: Newton-Raphson reciprocal unit
picked.description: Iteratively refines an initial seed estimate of 1/x, storing the current estimate and an iteration counter.

picked.name: Instruction fetch unit
picked.description: Generates fetch addresses and captures returned instruction bytes, keeping a fetch pointer and an alignment buffer.

picked.name: NAND flash controller
picked.description: Sequences command, address, and data cycles to a flash device, keeping a command state machine, page buffer, and status register.

picked.name: Pseudo-LRU tree unit
picked.description: Maintains a binary tree of direction bits per set and walks it to pick a victim way.

picked.name: Reed-Solomon encoder
picked.description: Appends parity symbols computed by a shift-register divider over a Galois field, keeping the symbol remainder registers.

picked.name: Breakpoint comparator unit
picked.description: Compares instruction or data addresses against programmed watch values, keeping address, mask, and control registers.

picked.name: Huffman decoder
picked.description: Consumes a variable-length bitstream and emits symbols using code-table memories, keeping a bit-accumulator register and bit-position counter.

picked.name: 2D sliding-window generator
picked.description: Assembles a KxK pixel neighborhood each cycle from line buffers into a register window array.

picked.name: Demultiplexer
picked.description: Routes a single input word to one of several output ports chosen by a select field.

picked.name: Branch target buffer
picked.description: Caches predicted target addresses for taken branches in a tag/target array with valid bits.

picked.name: Register rename table
picked.description: Maps architectural registers to physical tags, keeping the map array and a free-tag list.

picked.name: Wear-leveling mapping table
picked.description: Translates logical to physical blocks and records per-block erase counts in a mapping memory.

picked.name: AXI master port
picked.description: Issues address, write-data, and response channel transactions, keeping outstanding-transaction id registers and per-channel handshake state.

picked.name: Load-store queue
picked.description: Holds pending memory operations with addresses, data, and age fields and performs address matching between them.

picked.name: Hash table lookup engine
picked.description: Hashes a key, probes bucket memory, and compares stored keys, keeping probe index, bucket data, and match registers.

picked.name: Atomic compare-and-swap unit
picked.description: Reads a memory location, compares it to an expected value, and conditionally writes, keeping read-data, expected, and success-flag registers.

picked.name: Double-dabble converter
picked.description: Converts a binary value to packed BCD by iterative shift-and-add-3 steps, keeping a shift register of digits and a step counter.

picked.name: Direct-mapped cache
picked.description: Caches memory lines at index-determined slots, keeping tag, data, valid, and dirty arrays.

picked.name: Character display generator
picked.description: Renders text by fetching character codes and font rows, keeping a character memory, font ROM, and row/column counters.

picked.name: Equality comparator tree
picked.description: Reduces bitwise XOR results through an OR tree to signal whether two words differ, optionally registering the match bit.

picked.name: MISR signature analyzer
picked.description: Compresses an observed data stream into a signature register updated each cycle by feedback and XOR.

picked.name: Automatic gain control loop
picked.description: Adjusts an applied gain from measured signal amplitude, keeping an amplitude estimate register and a gain register.

picked.name: Population-count unit
picked.description: Counts the number of set bits in a word using a compressor tree, with an optional registered count output.

picked.name: Zigzag scan reorder buffer
picked.description: Reorders an 8x8 coefficient block between raster and zigzag order using a block memory and an index-sequence ROM.

picked.name: Microcode sequencer
picked.description: Selects the next control-store address from branch, jump, and increment sources, keeping a microprogram counter and a microsubroutine return register.

picked.name: Real-time clock
picked.description: Maintains seconds, minutes, hours, and calendar fields in dedicated registers updated by a one-hertz tick.

picked.name: Run-length encoder
picked.description: Emits value and repeat-count pairs from a stream, keeping a current-value register and a run-length counter.

picked.name: AES key expansion unit
picked.description: Derives per-round subkeys from the cipher key, holding the current key words and a round index register.

picked.name: I2C slave
picked.description: Responds to its programmed address and shifts bytes on the bus clock, keeping an address-match flag, shift register, and state machine.

picked.name: FIR filter
picked.description: Computes a weighted sum of recent samples using a tapped delay line of sample registers and a coefficient memory.

picked.name: SPI slave
picked.description: Shifts data in and out on an externally supplied clock, keeping receive and transmit shift registers and a bit index.

picked.name: Barrel shifter
picked.description: Shifts or rotates a word by an arbitrary amount in one pass through a cascade of multiplexer stages, holding no state.

picked.name: 8b/10b encoder
picked.description: Maps data bytes to balanced ten-bit symbols, keeping a running disparity bit.

picked.name: Borrow-propagate subtractor
picked.description: Computes the difference of two operands by propagating borrows through full-subtractor cells, holding only the final borrow bit.

picked.name: Victim cache
picked.description: Holds lines recently evicted from a main cache in a small fully associative array with tags and valid bits.

picked.name: Line fill buffer
picked.description: Collects returning beats of a memory line before writing it into the array, keeping a data buffer, beat index, and address register.

picked.name: CORDIC rotation engine
picked.description: Computes trigonometric or vector-rotation results by iterative shift-add micro-rotations, holding x, y, and angle accumulator registers plus an iteration index.

picked.name: CAN protocol controller
picked.description: Handles arbitration, bit stuffing, CRC, and acknowledgement for frames, keeping frame buffers, bit timing counters, and error counters.

picked.name: Barrier synchronization unit
picked.description: Tracks which participants have arrived using an arrival bit vector and releases them with a sense-reversal flag.

picked.name: Memory-map address decoder
picked.description: Compares an incoming address against programmed region descriptors and selects a target slave.

picked.name: I2C master
picked.description: Generates start, address, data, and stop phases on an open-drain bus, keeping a byte shift register, bit counter, and phase state register.

picked.name: Dual-port SRAM
picked.description: Provides two independent address and data ports into one storage array, with per-port address and output registers.

picked.name: Descrambler
picked.description: Recovers original data by XORing with a locally regenerated sequence held in a state shift register.

picked.name: Floating-point comparator
picked.description: Compares two floating-point operands including special-value cases and emits ordering and unordered flags, optionally registered.

picked.name: UART receiver
picked.description: Samples an asynchronous serial line at mid-bit and assembles a byte in a shift register with bit counter and framing-error flag.

picked.name: Window function multiplier
picked.description: Scales incoming samples by coefficients read from a window ROM addressed by a sample-index counter.

picked.name: CRC generator
picked.description: Updates a remainder register with each incoming data word using a polynomial division network.

picked.name: I2S audio interface
picked.description: Serializes or deserializes left/right audio samples against word-select and bit clocks, keeping sample shift registers and a channel flag.

picked.name: Dot-product unit
picked.description: Multiplies several operand pairs in parallel and sums them through an adder tree into a running sum register.

picked.name: Numerically controlled oscillator
picked.description: Generates sine and cosine samples by advancing a phase accumulator register and looking up a waveform table.

picked.name: AES round datapath
picked.description: Applies substitution, shifting, mixing, and key addition to a 128-bit state register for one cipher round.

picked.name: Directory coherence controller
picked.description: Sequences coherence messages for each line, keeping per-line sharer vectors, owner ids, and stable/transient state fields.

picked.name: Hazard detection unit
picked.description: Compares source and destination identifiers across pipeline stages to produce stall and bubble signals, reading the stage registers.

picked.name: Carry-save adder
picked.description: Reduces three input vectors to a sum vector and a carry vector, optionally registering both outputs for the next reduction stage.

picked.name: Floating-point multiplier
picked.description: Multiplies mantissas and adds exponents, then normalizes and rounds, holding pipeline registers for the product and exponent sum.

picked.name: Integer ALU
picked.description: Selects among add, subtract, logical, and compare operations on two operands and produces a result plus condition flags held in a flag register.

picked.name: GF(2^m) multiplier
picked.description: Multiplies two binary-field elements with polynomial reduction, keeping an accumulator register and the irreducible-polynomial configuration.
